transcript.text: How do you see the dichotomy between
duty and enjoyment as it relates to the
impact that you want to make with the
business that you have?
>> For me at least, I can tell you uh I
look at it as opportunity. I look at it
as um I I don't I don't feel a sense of
duty. I feel a sense of joy in being
able to contribute. I get into business
for impact and economics are second. If
I have enough impact, you'll never have
to worry about economics in your life.
And I found that to be true in my own
life. To me, contribution is what we're
made for. I don't look at duty and
enjoyment. I look at it as more like
it's all enjoyment because contribution
is the ultimate enjoyment for me. Cuz
the only thing that makes us feel alive
is growth.
